result.topic_en: A reader's note (apparently not by Ramanujan, likely Hardy or Watson) commenting that a manuscript appears very incomplete, querying whether certain numbered results follow, and checking parity relations among quantities v_1 to v_5.
result.transcription:
with Add Ms a 94$^{18}$ (16)

Apparently very incomplete [-(Does (6) follow from test zz-] )
(10)? & what diff does |c| make?
(13) & (14) ?
$v_3 - v_1$ : even $\quad v_1$ odd $\therefore v_3$ odd
$v_4 - v_2$ odd $\quad v_2$ even $\therefore v_4$ odd
$v_5 - v_3$ odd $\quad v_3$ odd $\therefore v_5$ even?

methods.what: Parity deduction: from the parity of a difference and of one term, infer the parity of the other term
methods.quote: $v_3 - v_1$ : even $\quad v_1$ odd $\therefore v_3$ odd

items.english: The manuscript appears to be very incomplete.
Does (10) hold or follow? And what difference does |c| make?

items.quote: $v_5 - v_3$ odd $\quad v_3$ odd $\therefore v_5$ even?
items.english: Since v_5 - v_3 is odd and v_3 is odd, is v_5 therefore even?
